metadata.title: How Many Days' Wages Would Cover the Basics?
metadata.description:
How many days of a London labourer's pay would cover a family's basic needs? This film follows a reconstructed basket of necessities from before the Black Death through the nineteenth century. Its wage-day figures compare a modeled annual basket with selected historical wage estimates; they are not records of any one family's spending or work year. The story follows a striking reversal: the basket becomes easier to cover, then harder, before taking a much smaller share of earnings in a later comparison.

#CostOfLiving #EconomicHistory #LondonHistory #PaperDetour
